body.message:
Hello,

I hope you’re doing well.

My departure date has now been confirmed, and I will be checking out tomorrow.

Unfortunately, due to an urgent family emergency, I will not be returning to the UAE for a long time, and I would like to cancel my booking.

Would that be possible?

Could you please explain the cancellation terms and let me know what options are available? I’m currently going through a very difficult time and need to make a decision as soon as possible.

Thank you for your understanding.
